verdict.rationale: Evidence shows an official CLI (cursor.com/cli) that lets users invoke Cursor from scripts, which partially satisfies 'driving the product programmatically,' but there is no documented public REST/SDK API, authentication scheme, or endpoint reference — MCP docs describe Cursor consuming external tools, not exposing itself as an API. Missing for 10: documented REST/GraphQL API, SDK/client libraries, API authentication and rate-limit docs, independent corroboration of programmatic usage.
